summary: Byggma ASA, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and supplies building materials in Norway, Great Britain, Sweden, Finland, Denmark, and internationally. It operates through Sheets, Beams, Windows, and Lighting Products segments. The company offers pre-painted ceilings and wall panels under the Huntonit brand; I-joist for use in walls, floors, and roof structures under the Masonite brand; and particle boards, boards, and structural panels for use in buildings, ceilings, and wall panels under the Forestia brand. It also provides doors and windows for new builds, extensions, and renovation projects under the Uldal brand; and a range of lighting products, such as decorative home lighting, lampshades, and professional functional lighting products under the Aneta Lighting brand. In addition, the company develops, manufactures, and distributes MDF panels for walls, ceilings, bathrooms, and kitchens under the Smartpanel brand. It sells its products through dealers and electrical wholesalers. The company was founded in 1997 and is headquartered in Vennesla, Norway. Byggma ASA operates as a subsidiary of Investor As.
